title: Canonical torus chart coactions satisfy the unit law
statement: Let $k$ be a field and $M$ a fine monoscheme with finite affine cover [def-trf-monoscheme-toric-realization]. Let $C$ be a torsion-free connected component of $M$, $L$ the group completion of its generic stalk, $X$ its component open in the toric realization $k[M]$, and $T=\operatorname{Spec}k[L]$, with the group structure $e^l\mapsto e^l\otimes e^l$, $e^l\mapsto1$, $e^l\mapsto e^{-l}$ [def-sc-group-scheme]. Suppose $a:T\times_k X\to X$ is a morphism over $k$ whose restriction to every component affine chart $\operatorname{Spec}k[P]$ is the spectrum of $e^p\mapsto e^{\deg(p)}\otimes e^p$, followed by the chart inclusion. Then $a(1,x)=x$ as morphisms over $k$, with the canonical unitors and associator of fibre products.

source.place: Expose VIII, 3.2.4, printed p.103; explicit chartwise verification and gluing in Step 6 of lem-trf-lattice-torus-coordinates-action.

proof.text: The component chart images cover X by its defining union. Pulling back this open cover also covers the source of the unit diagram.

On a chart P, evaluate the first factor of the coaction by the counit. It sends e^deg(p) tensor e^p to 1 times e^p=e^p. Since monomials span k[P], the composite is the identity algebra map. The affine fibre-product comparison translates this into the unit diagram on that chart.

The canonical-coaction hypothesis identifies these chart composites with the restrictions of a. Uniqueness of morphisms on the open chart cover gives the global unit identity; equality is also equality in Over Spec k because its forgetful functor is faithful.

theorem canonicalTorusCoaction_unit (k : Type u) [Field k] {M : Fine.{u}}
    (C : ToricComponent M)
    (a : ((Spec (.of (MonoidAlgebra k C.lattice))).asOver (Spec (.of k))) ⊗
        Over.mk (componentToBase k C) ⟶ Over.mk (componentToBase k C))
    (ha : IsCanonicalTorusAction k C a.left) :
    (η[((Spec (.of (MonoidAlgebra k C.lattice))).asOver (Spec (.of k)))] ▷
      Over.mk (componentToBase k C)) ≫ a =
        (λ_ (Over.mk (componentToBase k C))).hom
